data.text:
Manoj And Anr vs State And Anr (2024:Rj-Jd:9836) on 26
February, 2024
Author: Farjand Ali 
Bench: Farjand Ali
[2024:Rj-Jd:9836]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
 S.B. Criminal Misc. Petition No. 860/2017
1. Manoj S/o Pukhraj, Caste Jain, R/o Prem Nagar Siwana
 District Barmer.
2. M/ s Arihant Agency Siwana Through Manoj S/o Pukhraj, 
 Caste Jain, R/o Prem Nagar Siwana District Barmer. 
 ----Petitioners
 Versus
1. State Of Rajasthan
2. Food Inspector, Office Of Chief Medical And Health Officer,
 Barmer, District Barmer.
 ----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : None present
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Kumar, P.P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Farjand Ali
Order 26/02/2024
1. None present for the petitioners. 
2. The impugned order has been passed way back on 13.07.2015 whereby learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Balotra, District Barmer took cognizance for the offence 26[2][1] of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 
3. There is no interim order passed by this Court and thus, it can be presumed that much water has been flowed under the bridge. 
4. In this view of the matter, the criminal misc. petition is disposed of. 
5. Stay petition also stands disposed of.

6. The petitioners would be at liberty to agitate the issue before learned trial Court at appropriate stage for the trial is still underway. 
(FARJAND ALI),J 160-Ravi Khandelwal Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
